beats:
For a long time,
I’ve been writing
something in silence.

About survival.
About sacrifice.
About breaking —

You did not find this book;
this book found you.

cover.heading: Something is coming…
cover.quote:
You did not find this book;
this book found you.

caption:
kuch likh rahi thi… chupke se. 🤍

Not a ten-step guide. Not a lecture. Just a story about a family, a hospital corridor, and a girl who had to learn how to hold her own hand.

A Self Repaired Soul — my first book — is coming soon.

Turn on post notifications 🔔 so you're the first to know the date.

heading: Dear soul,
quote: Strength isn’t about never breaking — it’s about breaking and still choosing to return.
caption:
toot ke bhi wapas aana… that's the real strength 🫴🏻

Some days you defeat your weakness, some days it defeats you. Both are human.

Send this to the one who keeps coming back, no matter what. 🤍

📖 from my upcoming book, A Self Repaired Soul — coming soon

#trulyaariya #aselfrepairedsoul #healingjourney #selflove #mentalhealthmatters

heading: A gentle reminder,
quote: Healing itself doesn’t take time; we do.
caption:
waqt healing ko nahi lagta… humein lagta hai. 🍂

Time to open up to it. Time to let it touch the parts we've guarded for too long.

Save this for the day you feel 'stuck'. 🤍

heading: Note to self,
quote: You cannot stop people from throwing insults at you, but you can stop yourself from accepting them.
caption:
unki baatein unki soch… accept karna ya nahi, woh tumhari choice. ✌🏻

When a joke doesn't sit right, it stops being a joke.

Tag the friend who taught you to say no. 🫶🏻

What does self-love mean to you? 👇🏻
